Development on the game, begun in 1996, was notoriously protracted, and the game was often labeled vaporware.  "Return to Dark Castle" was originally scheduled to be released in Winter 2000, but was not released until March 14, 2008.  It brought colour to the original black and white graphics, and integrated the gameplay and levels of both the original games.

Like most Infocom games, thanks to the portable Z-machine, it was released for several platforms simultaneously.
